text: Westport Albion begins a patient attack from a throw-in just inside their own half on the right side. The ball is passed quickly among several players, moving forward across the right flank over 29 seconds. Aiden Zielinski carries the ball into the attacking third, then swings a cross from the right edge of the penalty area. Kenji Rahman, positioned about 5 metres from the goal at the near post, controls the cross and shoots with his foot, scoring to put Westport Albion ahead 3-2 at the Kingsmoor FC end.
